ns2:course.label: Literacy in the Info Age
ns2:course.description: A capstone course in the Information Technology Studies minor that draws on students' experience throughout their undergraduate program to discuss a series of themes such as community, the political sphere and education which have been impacted by the new information technologies. Same as COMM 491. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: LIS 201 or LIS 202.
